brief.aim: This table is the classic adult census income dataset, assembled to predict whether a person's income exceeds 50K, so income is the evident binary outcome once punctuation variants are merged. Remaining columns (age, workclass, education, occupation, hours, capital gains/losses, demographics) are pre-income attributes usable as features; fnlwgt is a sampling weight rather than a per-row key or target derivative, so nothing is flagged as leakage or identifier.
brief.repeated_subjects: No repeating subject key is present; each row is a separate respondent record.
brief.unit: One adult respondent in the US census income survey
